slides.h:
5 Word fixes for
when the formatting
won't behave.

slides.b: Paste as plain text. The words come in, the strange fonts and colours from the website don't.
Select the messy bit and clear its formatting. It goes back to your normal style.
Home, the ¶ button. Now you can see the extra spaces, breaks and empty lines causing the mess.
Heading stuck at the bottom of a page? Paragraph settings, Line and Page Breaks, Keep with next.
Right-click Normal in Styles, Modify. Set the font and 1.5 spacing there, not paragraph by paragraph.

Tell Toso what the document is for. Get it finished in Word, formatting done.
Pay with M-Pesa. No card, no monthly bill.
